claim_ladder.allowed_claim: In the tested model/task scope, plan-conditioned internal state contains a causal component that can selectively influence resumed branch preference after context reset.
evidence_required: Prospectively frozen ALFWorld causal plan-swap experiment passes all controls and guards on holdout data.
Active plan intervention beats lexical/order, random same-norm, unrelated-state and no-patch controls.
Full-plan positive control establishes model/task expressivity.

claim_ladder.allowed_claim: The scoped causal plan-state effect is prospectively replicable within the model/environment family.
evidence_required: Independent untouched ALFWorld confirmation cohort.
Layer/site/norm/statistic/tie handling frozen before confirmation.
No intervention retuning on confirmation.

claim_ladder.allowed_claim: An active plan can be checkpointed from one source context and causally restored after reset.
evidence_required: Learn/localize any global basis using development data only.
At test time extract checkpoint from the actually active plan alone; counterfactual B is unavailable to the extractor.
Single-source checkpoint restores/switches plan branch above generic latent-memory and text-matched controls.
SELF_PATCH/no-op numerical identity passes.

claim_ladder.allowed_claim: The intervention carries plan-level continuation state rather than only a one-step action feature.
evidence_required: Multi-step branch consistency after one-time restore.
First-action clamp/mediation control: force the same first action under A/B and retain a later plan-dependent divergence.
Ablating the identified state selectively damages plan continuation more than unrelated local competence.

claim_ladder.allowed_claim: A compact causal plan checkpoint can preserve useful execution state across context interruption in the tested setting.
evidence_required: Rank/dimension ablation establishes a small sufficient subspace and necessity trend.
Report checkpoint bytes/bits, global basis/projection bytes, amortized and non-amortized cost.
Compare against full KV cache, full residual state, full plan text, matched-token summary and generic hidden-state memory.
One-time checkpoint restore improves multi-step continuation and/or TaskSuccess without repeated steering.
forbidden_extensions: broad general LLM claim without model/environment replication

claim_ladder.allowed_claim: Causal plan-state checkpointing is a reproducible mechanism across multiple model/environment families, with demonstrated long-horizon utility.
claim_ladder.conference_bar: This is the target evidence tier for a strong ICLR/NeurIPS-style main-track claim.
evidence_required: Second model family with a predeclared precision/quantization interpretation gate.
Untouched confirmation data in each model family.
Second interactive environment with different semantics, executed only after primary ALFWorld support.
No benchmark switching to rescue a null primary mechanism.
End-task utility and causal persistence both reported.

compute_constraint: All future real model inference/activation work must use the user-authorized RTX 3050 host path; GPU-lab GTX 1650 must not be used for model workloads.
high_tier_minimum_story: Reproduce/extend Plans Don’t Persist with a causal question rather than another memory wrapper.
Show plan-specific A<->B causal transplantation under matched observable state and strong lexical/generic controls.
Convert paired causal localization into a single-source checkpoint usable at test time.
Demonstrate multi-step plan-level persistence beyond first-action steering.
Establish compactness with honest storage accounting and necessity/sufficiency ablations.
Replicate on a second model family and a second interactive environment without post-hoc benchmark rescue.
Separate mechanistic claims, compactness claims, and end-task utility claims throughout the paper.

kill_or_narrow_outcomes.consequence: Kill the tested single-site plan-specific causal-contrast mechanism; do not build a memory module.
kill_or_narrow_outcomes.outcome: Active intervention does not beat lexical/random/unrelated controls in a valid holdout

kill_or_narrow_outcomes.consequence: Narrow to action-feature steering; forbid plan-state/persistence claim.
kill_or_narrow_outcomes.outcome: Effect beats controls but disappears under first-action clamp or after one step

kill_or_narrow_outcomes.consequence: Keep mechanistic localization result only; PlanCarry checkpoint method is not established.
kill_or_narrow_outcomes.outcome: Paired contrast works but single-source extraction fails

kill_or_narrow_outcomes.consequence: Kill compactness claim; mechanistic result may remain.
kill_or_narrow_outcomes.outcome: Checkpoint requires near-full hidden/KV state or basis overhead exceeds text replay

kill_or_narrow_outcomes.consequence: Architecture-specific result; no general LLM claim.
kill_or_narrow_outcomes.outcome: ALFWorld replicates but second model family fails

kill_or_narrow_outcomes.consequence: Environment/task-specific scope; no general agent-persistence claim.
kill_or_narrow_outcomes.outcome: Cross-model passes but second environment fails

kill_or_narrow_outcomes.consequence: Mechanistic paper possible if effect is strong/novel; agent-method utility claim is forbidden.
kill_or_narrow_outcomes.outcome: Causal effect exists but end-task utility is null/negative

kill_or_narrow_outcomes.consequence: Experiment is inconclusive/model-task incapable, not evidence against the broader hypothesis.
kill_or_narrow_outcomes.outcome: Full-plan positive control fails or pair construction cannot provide enough capable pairs

novelty_forbidden_claims: Locating or activation-patching planning representations itself is novel.
Using hidden states as memory itself is novel.
A one-model ALFWorld effect establishes a general LLM plan-state mechanism.
A paired A-vs-B contrast is already a deployable checkpoint from one active plan.
The representation is compact unless per-episode payload plus global basis/projection overhead are accounted in bits/bytes.
A first-action logit shift alone demonstrates persistent plan state.
purpose: Pre-outcome conference-positioning and reviewer kill-gates. This artifact does not change experiment design or scientific belief.

gate: Exact lexical-content counterbalancing/order swap.
Archived non-active lexical-order control with same action strings.
Active effect must exceed lexical control prospectively.
Prefer delayed divergence after a shared prefix.
reviewer_objection_gates.objection: Lexical or object/action identity steering, not plan state

gate: Random same-norm control.
Unrelated-plan contrast control.
Norm-matched patch mathematics frozen.
Active effect must exceed both controls.
Multi-step branch endpoint.
First-action clamp/mediation control.
Later branch behavior must remain checkpoint-dependent.
Second model family required before general claim.
Freeze per-family adaptation protocol before confirmation.
Quantized model results require baseline-expressivity and SELF_PATCH numerical gates and cannot be silently equated with full-precision results.
1.5B may be discovery only.
At least one >=3B/4B different family or stronger open model must replicate for high-tier general claim.
Report model capability/full-plan expressivity explicitly.
Plan text absent after reset.
Single injection/checkpoint restore only.
Measure decay/branch consistency across several subsequent action-observation steps and terminal success.
Count per-episode checkpoint payload and global basis/projection overhead.
Report bits/bytes and compression ratio vs text/KV/full residual.
Minimality/rank ablations required.
ALFWorld primary mechanism must support first.
ScienceWorld/second environment remains dependency-gated confirmation only.
Null ALFWorld cannot be rescued by changing environment.
T1/T2 results must be described as causal localization only.
Deployment claim forbidden until T3 single-source extractor works without counterfactual B at test time.
reviewer_objection_gates.objection: Paired contrast is not a deployable memory method

gate: Report TaskSuccess and repeated/reversed action rates after one-time restore.
Compare matched storage/token baselines.
Mechanistic causal result and utility result must be stated separately.
